name: card-guard
summary: Refuses a decision card written in engineering text (ids, hashes, file names, raw JSON, no proof, no consequence, Yes/No-only options) and lets a worker file its own card with a per-run cap.

env.WORKER_CARD_STATE: optional: where the per-run cap bookkeeping lives
env.WORKER_CARD_RUN: optional: run key for the cap (default: session id plus ticket)
